capabilities: sync documents from reMarkable Cloud into a vault subfolder
render .rm notebook drawings as high-fidelity PDFs with pen types and colors
merge handwritten annotations with the original PDF background
run incremental sync on a configurable auto-sync interval
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is a one-way download of tablet documents into the vault as PDFs, not a two-way vault sync.
extras: Desktop-only (requires the Obsidian desktop app). Listed in the community plugin directory but flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Auth tokens are stored outside the vault at ~/.remarkable-sync/token.json; no telemetry is collected. The author requests donations and hosts feature voting.
problem: Handwritten notes and annotations made on a reMarkable tablet stay in the reMarkable Cloud and cannot be read or searched inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: The .rm file parsing implementation in this plugin is based on / inspired by rmscene by Rick Lupton

summary: Pulls documents from a reMarkable Paper Pro tablet via reMarkable Cloud and saves them into the vault as rendered PDFs.
